policy_rules: Phase 7C.2R4P4 is permanently closed with status FAIL.
Future work may NOT continue automatically as R4P4-R4 or R4P5.
Any future investigation into structural alignment must be chartered under an explicitly new approved phase identifier.
A future phase proposal must pre-declare: NEW_PHASE_ID, NEW_HYPOTHESIS, FROZEN_BASELINE, FROZEN_METRIC_NAMESPACE, FROZEN_HARD_BOUNDS, and PREDECLARED_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.
No future phase may assume as an inherited fact that parallax is dominant, nor that rigid geometry is definitively unrecoverable.
